title: [Prime] Ugreen FineTrack Rechargeable Smart Tag 4-Pack Duo $41.32, iOS $38.93 Delivered @ Ugreen via Amazon AU
body:
Deal: [Prime] Ugreen FineTrack Rechargeable Smart Tag 4-Pack Duo $41.32, iOS $38.93 Delivered @ Ugreen via Amazon AU

[KaliKaliKali] Cheapest I can get it is $47.48. What am I missing?
[hopper] add to cart and move to check out, you will see the discount applied on the final screen as mentioned in post
[KaliKaliKali] I did that… That's still the price I get… Also applied the discounts
[hopper] not sure , but works for me on mobile and desktop
[bamzero] Should be a 22% off $20+ spend offer automatically applied.
[olympicwiz] Thanks OP got them for $41.32 as described
[preasm14] These have rechargeable battery. Do they allow these in check-in luggage?
[Chmmr] Yes (AFAIK). I put one in my luggage and went to Singapore —> England —> Ireland and back last month and had no issues.
AFAIK: Meaning they didn't pull it out of the bag or detect it.
[Yorkshire-Man] I actually like iOS, but I just couldn't cope with the hardware downgrade… 100w charging is something I can't go back from (and so many other things).
[JoseJoseJose] Just a quick heads-up I believe you can only pair it to one system at a time. I personally didn't know that but I read it somewhere.
[CrazySurfaNZ] Yep one system either iOS or Android, it was on the listing
[yoquierotaco] Recently moved to iOS and not sure how long i can survive
I recently moved to Android and I'm trying to move back to IOS lol. To each their own I guess. Too many things on Android annoys me compared to iOS.
[lawyerz] Too each their own indeed. I found the opposite. Since you're with android for the time being, one of the best features is the ability to install 3 versions of the same app (via island + private space / secure folder) or sideload morphe apps to get YouTube, Spotify, etc without ads. Power users will like FTP server and terminal via termux.
Try out morphe
[TheFreaK] Why would I want 3 versions of the same app
[Blitzfx] Different logins / by pass in-app restrictions / different working app environment
[Xheis] Okay product, but this is pretty close to regular price anyways?
[fruxo] Are all of these as good as each other, besides general brand quality etc? They all use the same technology I think, ie Bluetooth pinging, so I assume it would be much of the same?
I'm normally very happy with ugreen, but I'm not sure if these are potentially missing important features compared to more expensive ones. I'm happy to pay a bit extra if others are better at tracking I mean, but quality wise ugreen is usually perfect. This is for Android.
[bashar20] Would like to know the same but for iOS. Are these the ones to get it are there better options for iOS?
